subcategory_description: Payments from the government for people who are out of work or on leave.
label: Parental Leave Pay rate per day, before tax
context: The daily rate for leave taken in the financial year. It is based on the national minimum wage and usually changes on 1 July. The rate depends on when the leave is taken, not on when the child was born or adopted.

subcategory_description: Payments from the government for people who are out of work or on leave.
label: Parental Leave Pay rate per 5 day week, before tax
context: The weekly equivalent of the daily rate, based on a 5 day week.

subcategory_description: Payments from the government for people who are out of work or on leave.
label: Parental Leave Pay days available to a family
context: The most days a family can get for a child born or adopted from 1 July 2026. Earlier births have fewer: 120 days from 1 July 2025 and 110 days from 1 July 2024.

subcategory_description: Payments from the government for people who are out of work or on leave.
label: Parental Leave Pay days reserved for a partner
context: For a child born or adopted from 1 July 2026, this many of the days are reserved for the partner. The rest are shared by agreement.

subcategory_description: Payments from the government for people who are out of work or on leave.
label: Most Parental Leave Pay days that can be taken at the same time
context: For a child born or adopted from 1 July 2025. Some exemptions apply.

subcategory_description: Payments from the government for people who are out of work or on leave.
context: The Paid Parental Leave Superannuation Contribution is based on this rate.
